_doc: [camp] The landing yard (systems/camp/camp.gd, systems/camp/yard_builds.gd). A fresh base starts with only the pod, a broken workbench and the trash bin. Lumi repairs the bench (bench_repair_s) the first time E is pressed at it. Yard builds are bought in the Hub tab: requires_level is the hub level, requires_flag a GameState flag (first_sprout = the first seed has grown). pos is [x, z] in the yard (CityLayout.YARD_HALF = 8.5; the fence runs along the back and both sides, the front at +z is open). Keep every yard interactable at least min_gap metres from the next. Every yard structure is a Hub-tab build (systems/camp/hub_builds.gd): once-builds drop off the list when built; tiered ones (trash bin, signal tower) show only their next tier. requires_bench: only after the workbench is repaired. camera_bot (camp3): global (one build for the whole game, GameState.flags.yard_global), unlocked at hub level 2 or after or_played_s seconds of play, and not listed before that (hidden_until_unlocked). Photo mode needs him (ui/photo_mode.gd). [M3-19] Yard builds cost cubes only (Parts pay for robots and machines; design spec section 14), in the first city's scale. locker (design spec section 13): offered once the first piece of a look is found (requires_flag first_piece, set by systems/looks.gd); turntable = where its turntable stands, [x, z] in the locker's own frame (x along its face, z out from its doors). flag_text: what the Build tab says while requires_flag is not met.

shack.name: Lean-to
shack.desc: Salvaged pipe and corrugated iron over the workbench, with a work lamp. Shelter for the crew.

generator.name: Generator
generator.desc: A patched portable generator by the lean-to. It hums; the yard feels lived in.

lamps.name: Yard Lamps
lamps.desc: The street lamp and the pole lamps along the fence, rewired. Light for the yard at night.

composter.name: Compost Press
composter.desc: Presses plant scraps into compost and seeds. Worth building once something grows.

radio.name: CD Player
radio.desc: A chunky old CD player on a crate by the fence. Plays the discs you find.

locker.name: Locker
locker.desc: A tall steel locker with a small turntable. Step up to wear the pieces you have found, and to dress Glim and your robots.
locker.flag_text: Find a piece of a look first.

nursery.name: Robot Nursery
nursery.desc: A walled lawn with flower beds where retired robots tend the garden and lend your crew a hand.

glim.name: Repair Glim
glim.desc: The little lantern bot who held on to your pod all the way down. Patch him up and he'll follow you and light the way.

camera_bot.name: Blink
camera_bot.desc: A little floating camera bot with a big lens for a face. Builds once; then he follows Lumi from base to base and photo mode opens.

field_bench._doc: [M3-22] The field bench at every city's base (systems/camp/field_benches.gd, field_bench_sites.gd, field_bench_model.gd). Once Lumi reaches a city other than the start one, a packed bench kit waits on the site's bench anchor by the landing pad; E there sets it up (cost, may be empty = free), and from then on it gives the whole workbench (upgrades, rigs, research, robot building, the Assembler's mix). Robots built there join that city's base. The start yard keeps the Locker, the yard builds and the Assembler building itself (the Build tab says so at a field bench). reach_m: how close Lumi stands to use it. looks: per district id, the bench's colours [r, g, b]: frame (legs and rails), panel (cabinet and pegboard), canopy (the tarp over it), trim (crates, bins, the stencil band); default: a city not listed.
